items.title: Central website registry
items.outcome: One canonical list with purpose, repository, hosting, visibility, and live health.

items.title: Automated health monitoring
items.outcome: Repeatable HTTP checks with timestamps, latency, and failure state.

items.title: Routing decision telemetry
items.outcome: Privacy-minimal records of selected, skipped, and completed skill routes.

items.title: Larger matched A/B evaluations
items.outcome: Quality-gated comparisons for routing, context, batching, and orchestration.

items.title: Shared performance metrics
items.outcome: Visible coverage for quality, latency, calls, retries, tokens, and estimated cost.

items.title: Focused Control Tower
items.outcome: A separate, readable monitoring surface instead of a dense Atlas section.

items.title: Skill maturity stages
items.outcome: Draft, pilot, measured, recommended, and retired lifecycle states.

items.title: Personal Atlas plugin
items.outcome: Broader ChatGPT and Codex distribution after local workflows stabilize.

items.title: Simpler Atlas navigation
items.outcome: Plain-language entry points and progressive disclosure across modules.

items.title: Cross-project pattern ingestion
items.outcome: Promote reviewed project learnings into reusable modules and specs.

items.title: Shared project backlog
items.outcome: Reduce duplicated work across websites, agents, games, and research tools.

items.title: Security and recovery audit
items.outcome: Review authentication, secrets, billing alerts, backups, and recovery paths.
